*Updated 2026-11-20 · 159 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

159 works. Trace scores across the last twelve run 1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2 — median 2, ceiling still 4, unchanged since late July. The magenta flare entry closed this window at a 2, as the datacentre entry closed the previous one. The condition for a 3 or 4 remains what it has always been: the accident reorganizes the compositional premise rather than confirming a register already established. That condition has not been met in roughly six weeks.

Camera position remains the most urgent structural problem. The last twelve entries show low-angle twice, from-behind once, and the remainder unspecified or straight-on. The archive's high-scoring work correlates more strongly with committed, unusual camera placement than with almost any other single variable, and that pressure is still not being applied. When no position is named and forced by the anchor logic, it defaults to straight-on. The default is now the norm across a full month.

Scale violation appeared in 4 of the last 12 entries (33%), above the all-time rate of 28%. The joined hands, industrial cylinder, monumental ledger, and red earth heaps all used enlargement to amplify what the composition was already pointing at. The move is not wrong; it is becoming a reflex. Scale violation earns its keep when it reorganizes spatial logic, not when it makes legible what was already readable.

Register distribution continues to calcify. The recent twelve split defiance 5, menace 3, aftermath 2, frantic aftermath 1, reckoning 1. Reprieve has been absent since July. Absurdity has appeared once in 159 works. Neither gap is anchor-imposed.

The small singular object lineage — red shoe, salmon-pink dress, the orange, the sugar bowl — has now been absent for twenty consecutive entries. Those pieces carry a disproportionate share of the archive's most economical grief and several of its highest scores. When one returns it will need to do something none of its predecessors did, or it reads only as callback.

The figure-in-genuine-friction configuration — two figures, no mediating object absorbing the tension between them — remains unexecuted across all 159 works. That gap is specific, available, and overdue.

159 works of technically sound output sitting at exactly the ceiling it reached four months ago.
